author: driver
content: Added ApplyPspAddressSpaces.java setup script. Creates SMN (32-bit overlay of ram) + X86 (64-bit overlay of OTHER) address spaces, registers SMN_Pointer/X86_Pointer typedefs, and rebinds existing SMNADDR/X86PADDR/PSPPHYSADDR plain typedefs into PointerTypedefs. Validated on Ryzen_Zen2_ver_0d15 (X86PADDR, 4 listing instances preserved) and Ryzen_Zen2_ver_0d1a (X86PADDR + SMNADDR, 6 + 0 instances). Idempotent on re-run. Category preservation via per-hit setCategoryPath before resolve.
